name: alt-grid-survives-a-shrink
about: The alternate screen is TOP-ANCHORED: shrinking its height discards from the bottom and leaves the content where it was, where a primary viewport would scroll to keep the cursor visible. The cursor agrees with xterm: resizeGrid clamps the row to the new last row and only clamps the column when it is past the last COLUMN, which it is not here. protocol/conformance/wterm-0.5.0-roost.patch, resizeGrid's top_anchored argument.
patch: resizeGrid passes top_anchored for the alternate grid, clamping the cursor after discarding the bottom
diverges_from_v2: rio-vt scrolls the alternate grid on a shrink to keep the cursor visible; Roost does not carry the old top-anchor patch (P3). The viewport keeps the two bottom rows (ccc, ddd) where v2 kept the two top rows (aaa, bbb); the cursor agrees.
